title: Effects of fluorinated ski wax bans on per-and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) concentrations in indoor dust from ski waxing workspaces
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00024J, Paper
Kathryn A. Crawford, Nicola Hartmann, Emilia Andersen, Celeste Alden, Divya Gudur, Bharat Chandramouli
Consumer products such as ski and snowboard (“ski”) wax can contain very high concentrations of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS; up to 100% by mass), attracting attention from scientific experts...
